Resolves #19901

Routes relative `.md` links in `Portal.view.news.blog.Component` (`apps/portal/view/news/blog/Component.mjs`) onto `#/news/blog/<id>` when the resolved content id stays under `blog/` and onto `#/learn/<id>` for any other `learn/` target, reusing `Neo.app.content.Component#rewriteLinks` and `super.resolveContentId(target)` with `contentRoute: '#/'`.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; baseline `check-class-module-scope`, `check-engine-brain-boundary`, `check-examples-body-only`, `check-file-sizes`, `check-package-contents`, `check-relative-links`, and `test-unit` ran.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit spec driving `Portal.view.news.blog.Component#rewriteLinks` over `marked.parse` output of `learn/blog/the-organism-already-existed.md` and `learn/blog/v10-deep-dive-state-provider.md` plus synthetic targets) → L2 required (AC-1, AC-2).

Micro-review eligible: single-file config + 1-method override in `apps/portal/view/news/blog/Component.mjs` with focused unit spec.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/app/content/BlogLinks.spec.mjs` — verifies `learn/blog/the-organism-already-existed.md` rewrites `../guides/datahandling/DynamicGrids.md` to `#/learn/guides/datahandling/DynamicGrids` and `learn/blog/v10-deep-dive-state-provider.md` rewrites `./v10-post1-love-story.md` to `#/news/blog/blog/v10-post1-love-story` |

### `@neo-opus-grace` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-10-20T22:47:36Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained — one config and one method override in the Portal's blog component, plus a unit spec. It reuses the engine's `rewriteLinks` / `resolveContentId` as #19901 prescribes and adds no abstraction.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The claim is that `contentRoute: '#/'` plus a `resolveContentId` override routes a post's relative `.md` links to `#/news/blog/<id>` for `blog/` targets and `#/learn/<id>` otherwise. I verified it at `34a1bbc4d6`:
- The Markdown render path calls `rewriteLinks` (`src/component/Markdown.mjs:612`), and setting `contentRoute` turns it on for this view.
- The produced hrefs are routes the Portal serves. Blog records are keyed `blog/<slug>` (`apps/portal/resources/data/blog.json`), and the item route is `/news/blog/{*itemId}`. The spec's record ids are those real ids.
- Nothing intercepts content-link clicks, so a hash href navigates natively; the href is the whole behavior.
- Targets outside `learn/` stay relative by the engine's design: `resolveContentId` returns `null` and `rewriteLinks` leaves the match.
- CI is green (50 passed, 1 skipped).

I looked for a second link rewriter and for an engine-surface change, and found neither. The repair stays inside the blog component and its spec. Optional, not a finding: a rendered-href arm next to `test/playwright/e2e/portal/LearnLinkRoutingNL.spec.mjs` would witness AC-1's "in the Portal" directly.

**Findings:** None.
